meta.name: data-engineering
meta.description: Builds and operates data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, orchestration, quality testing, and reliability of data delivery. Use this to design or debug a pipeline, decide batch versus streaming, add data quality checks, handle late or duplicate data, or work out why a dashboard's numbers changed without anyone changing the dashboard.

copy.tagline: 整合分散数据,让报表数字稳定可信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果报表数字经常对不上,你总在猜数据为何变化
copy.tagline_en: Automate data flows to keep reports accurate and reliable
copy.fit_line_en: For you if reports often show wrong numbers and you're always figuring out why

howto.what: 装上后，当你处理数据管道时，Claude会引导你保留原始数据、把转换放在下游，并设计可安全重跑的流程；也会帮你排查迟到或重复数据、仪表板数字变化，在管道中校验数据质量并在失败时明确报警。
howto.when: 当你说要设计或调试数据管道、加数据质量检查，或处理迟到/重复数据等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计从订单API到数仓的每日管道，应选批处理还是流式？
say.note: Claude会给选型建议，并提醒保留原始数据。

say.text: 重跑后数字翻倍了，怎么把管道改成幂等？
say.note: Claude会建议用确定性键和合并/覆盖，而不是盲目追加。

say.text: 仪表板没改但数字变了，帮我查管道哪里有问题。
say.note: Claude会检查迟到数据、重复记录及事件时间分区。

howto.what_en: When working on pipelines, Claude will advise keeping raw data immutable, transforming downstream, and making re-runs safe. It also debugs late/duplicate data and dashboard changes, testing data quality and failing loudly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to design/debug a data pipeline, add data quality checks, or handle late/duplicate data.

say_en.text: Help me design a daily pipeline from order API to warehouse—batch or streaming?
say_en.note: Recommends an approach and reminds you to keep raw data.

say_en.text: Re-runs double my counts; can you make the pipeline idempotent?
say_en.note: Suggests deterministic keys and merge/overwrite, not appends.

say_en.text: Dashboard numbers changed with no edits—help me trace the pipeline issue.
say_en.note: Checks for late data, duplicates, and event-time partitioning.
